vb_textbox.text: The amount that each gnome provides seems to change throughout the game. For a while, one gnome of each pair will reward more points, but that will change several times throughout the game. If a gnome starts rewarding only a few points, such as less than 3, try the other gnome. If you continually stay alert and avoid sticking with a gnome that is rewarding few points, then you will maximize your output.
